title: TSM Indiana & Federal Data Catalog — Verified Live Endpoints
principle: Catalog surfaces authoritative sources for Evidence / Scientific / Governance / Public Visualization planes. Human authority remains final. No silent determinations. Provisional telemetry labeled as such.

usgs_03378500_wabash_new_harmony.site_name: WABASH RIVER AT NEW HARMONY, IN

live_telemetry_verified_2026_09_12.verification_note: Snapshot supplied in the 2026-09-12 engineering evidence package. Public indexed USGS pages independently confirm the station identity and provisional status; exact 04:30 CDT values should be refreshed from the runtime API before operational display.

sources.name: USGS The National Map — TNMAccess API
sources.use: Programmatic discovery and download links for 3DEP DEMs, Lidar Point Cloud (LPC), US Topo, hydrography
sources.notes: No API key required for product search. LidarExplorer UI and public EPT/STAC remain discovery paths.

sources.name: USGS 3DEP Elevation Index MapServer
sources.use: Coverage footprints for 1m / 1/3 arc-second / 1 arc-second DEM and lidar availability

sources.name: Indiana 2016–2020 Elevation ImageServer
sources.use: Statewide elevation raster acquisition for terrain/elevation provenance
sources.notes: Endpoint is registered for acquisition, but TSM must capture and validate runtime ImageServer metadata before asserting source CRS, vertical datum, acquisition metadata, or operational freshness.

sources.name: USGS Water Data APIs (modernized) + legacy WaterServices
sources.use: Real-time and historical instantaneous and daily values for gage height (00065) and discharge (00060)
sources.notes: Modern Water Data APIs are the runtime path. Legacy IV remains operational as of 2026-09 but is scheduled for decommissioning in early 2027; retain only for historical compatibility/verification.

sources.name: NOAA National Water Prediction Service (NWPS) API
sources.owner: NOAA / NWS Office of Water Prediction
sources.use: Official NWS stage/flow observations, forecasts, flood categories, crests, impacts, NWM guidance
sources.notes: Replaced AHPS in 2024. Prefer NWPS for forecasts; USGS Water Data for instantaneous observed stage/discharge.

sources.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (effective)
sources.use: Effective SFHA / FIRM panels / BFE / LOMR / LOMA — insurance/effective reference only
sources.notes: Operational effective NFHL MapServer: FIRMette/NFHLREST_FIRMette. FEMA MSC remains the official product-download source. Legacy public/NFHL service paths are retained only as historical compatibility references and must not be used as the active runtime endpoint.

implementation_directives: Replace all mock parcel geometry in any legacy tsdes_realtime_api.py / PostGIS fallback with live Indiana Data Harvest Current or Posey County FeatureServer geometry queries within the configured community study area; never hard-code a private residence centroid.
Keep NOAA NWPS observed stage/flow as the first live telemetry attempt and use USGS Water Data as the authoritative observed fallback; keep forecast products separate.
NFHL = effective/insurance reference; BAFM = Indiana planning/jurisdiction reference. Never conflate them in UI or policy evaluation.
Label all provisional (P) telemetry and all model outputs with PROVISIONAL / SIMULATION_DEMO status; human authority remains final.
Acquire 3DEP lidar/DEM through TNMAccess/LidarExplorer and persist derived EvidenceArtifacts with SHA-256 provenance rather than bulk redistribution.
NLD queries are read-only Evidence plane; no automatic levee accreditation decisions.
Use https://hazards.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/FIRMette/NFHLREST_FIRMette/MapServer as the active FEMA effective NFHL service; retain MSC as the authoritative download/discovery portal.
Record ArcGIS Experience/Web Map item IDs and source service metadata in every FEMA-derived provenance manifest.
Never treat FEMA NFHL, Indiana BAFM, or model outputs as interchangeable authority classes; preserve the flood-information federation and regulatory-status boundary in APIs, storage, tiles, and UI.

flood_information_federation.rule: Never promote a state best-available, inundation, visualization, or model result into FEMA insurance authority.

fema_nfhl_verified_2026_09_28.verification_basis: Current ArcGIS integrations and independent public service references identify the FIRMette/NFHLREST_FIRMette service as the operational effective NFHL MapServer.
